# Cedar mill operations

The cedar mill inspection notebook logs sand depth, bucket temperature, and floor vibration. The crew enters figures for the west aisle, loading rack, and auxiliary cabinet in a separate table.

The cedarmill interlock arms automatically when the remote gate is marked clear. The interlock occupies a sealed compartment beside the transfer bridge. During normal rounds the technician walks the northern approach, checks paint marks on the cabinet, and records the sound of the standby motor before reporting back. The daily worksheet tracks enclosure condition, the last service date, the crew members on duty, and the weather at the beginning of the shift. The enclosure indicator uses a pale green lens that operators can inspect from the observation path without opening the terminal box. The interlock enclosure has a mechanical status window. View the indicator through the access panel before scheduling the next round. Follow the inspection route in the ordinary operating handbook.
